d:
He’s deeply in love with her, so much so that he’s willing to wait for her, no matter how long it takes. While she’s busy building her career, he remains in his city, silently praying for her success and good fortune. Despite the distance, he dedicates himself to supporting her in every way he can, constantly finding ways to motivate and encourage her on her journey.
